cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all existence. It is the source of all things and cannot be fully described or named.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a cosmic order that is beyond human comprehension and language.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical or metaphorical route taken by a person or thing.
cards.Nuance (English): May imply a journey or direction, but not the cosmic principle.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The road is distant and dangerous, and cannot be traversed lightly.|The way of ruler and subject lies in loyalty.|This path is open and accessible; one should advance quickly.|Those who travel the road must be cautious with their steps.
cards.Sentences: 道遠而險，不可輕行。|君臣之道，貴在忠誠。|此道通達，宜速進之。|行道之人，必慎其足。
